Spot on!
Sep 2026 • Solo
★★★★★

Had a really enjoyable meal at Sài Gòn Kitchen Vina. The restaurant has a relaxed, charming atmosphere and feels comfortable rather than overly touristy.

I ordered the Bún Chả Giò (fried spring rolls with vermicelli) and Bún Chả Hà Nội (Hanoi grilled pork with vermicelli). Both were good, but the Bún Chả Hà Nội was definitely my favorite — really delicious! The grilled pork was flavorful and went very well with the fresh herbs, vermicelli, and dipping sauce.

What also stood out was the service. The staff were kind, welcoming, and very attentive throughout the meal without being intrusive.

Good Vietnamese food, pleasant surroundings, and genuinely nice service. A very enjoyable lunch and definitely a place I’d be happy to visit again.

Wonderful experience

First, I really like the comfortable, cool, and clean atmosphere of the restaurant; I am also impressed by your very Vietnamese decorative style. The food is wonderful, the flavor is excellent, I really like the tarpon hotpot at the restaurant, the fish meat is incredibly fresh combined with green vegetables blended with the sour and spicy hotpot broth is truly a wonderful symphony to eat. I am particularly impressed with the grilled chicken at the restaurant; it is very fragrant, the chicken skin is very crispy, and the sauce is extremely delicious. Delicious food
Jan 2026 • Couples
We 'found' this restaurant through TripAdvisor based on its proximity to our hotel as much as anything else. It was the first evening after our flight so we were tired and were eating earlier then we normally would - 6pm. The restaurant was quiet but it meant that we had a table on the first floor looking out over the busy street.
We didn't order particularly wisely so ended up with lots more greenery on our plates than we were looking for but everything we ordered was delicious. The guy who served us was helpful and friendly but perhaps could have guided our choices a bit better. But that's the only negative.
